identificationModule.briefTitle: Targeted Alpha-emitter Therapy of PRRT Naïve and Previous PRRT Neuroendocrine Tumor Patients
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Open Label Study to Evaluate the Safety and Effectiveness of 212Pb-DOTAMTATE in Subjects With Somatostatin Receptor Expressing Neuroendocrine Tumors

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Multicenter Phase 2 study of 212Pb-DOTAMTATE enrolling adult subjects with positive somatostatin positive neuroendocrine tumors with either no prior history of peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (PRRT naive) or prior history of peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (Previous PRRT)
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: In this open-label, multicenter, single-arm Phase 2 study, adult subjects with histologically confirmed NETs and positive somatostatin analog imaging, with either no prior PRRT (PRRT naive) or prior history of peptide receptor radionuclide therapy (previous PRRT) will be enrolled to receive 212Pb-DOTAMTATE 67.6 μCi/kg dose per cycle

armGroups.label: Pb212-DOTAMTATE
armGroups.description: investigational radiotherapeutic drug targeting somatostatin receptor-positive neuroendocrine tumors in PRRT naive patients (Cohort 1) and previous PRRT patients (Cohort 2)

interventions.name: AlphaMedix
interventions.description: 212Pb-DOTAMTATE is a radiolabeled derivative of octreotide targeting somatostatin positive neuroendocrine tumors

primaryOutcomes.measure: Measurement of the objective response rate by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) 1.1 criteria.
primaryOutcomes.description: The morphological imaging (CT/MRI) will be done before therapy and selected time points before therapy cycle to determine changes in the size of target lesions.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of patients with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v.4.0
primaryOutcomes.description: To assess the safety and tolerability of 212Pb-DOTAMTATE

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Measurement of the Median Progression free survival (mPFS)
secondaryOutcomes.description: PFS will be defined as the number of days from the first dose of 212Pb-DOTAMTATE to documented tumor progression per RECIST 1.1 criteria or death due to any cause.
OS will be defined as the number of days from the first dose of 212Pb-DOTAMTATE to the date of death due to any cause or the date of last contact (censored observations) at the data cut-off date.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Measurement of Time to Tumor Progression (TTP)
secondaryOutcomes.description: This measurement will determine the time from start of treatment with 212Pb- DOTAMTATE until disease progression.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate health-related quality of life (HRQL) using ECOG performance status
secondaryOutcomes.description:
Changes in quality of life will be assessed relative to baseline.

Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) is designed to measure how cancer affects subject's daily life and is assessed using 0-5 scale.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate health-related quality of life (HRQL) using HRQL questionnaire EORTC QLQ-C30
secondaryOutcomes.description:
Changes in quality of life will be assessed relative to baseline.

European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer (EORTC) QLQ-C30 is a self-assessed questionnaire that consists of 30 questions designed to measure varying types of functioning, symptoms and overall health/quality of life. It is assessed using either a 4-point scale or 7-point scale, depending on the question.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: To evaluate health-related quality of life (HRQL) using HRQL questionnaire EORTC QLQ-G.I.NET21
secondaryOutcomes.description:
Changes in quality of life will be assessed relative to baseline.

European Organisation for Research and Treatment of Cancer (EORTC) QLQ-G.I.NET21 is a self-assessed questionnaire that consists of 51 questions designed to assess symptoms or problems. It is assessed using a 4-point scale.
